testcase.name: continuing after an earlier conflict uses rename semantics for the next replayed commit
abort split rename replay restores the original local name and retains an unrelated draft
linked replay provenance is not followed to invent rename relationships
replay rename versus deletion always pauses and preserves explicit keep or delete choices
abort preserves an ignored original filename introduced during author resolution
persisted single parent cherry picks use their parent to group split renames
author resolution cannot redirect replay or introduce an ignored file overwrite
renamed replay content conflicts retain complete stages and continue in a new service
split replay renames form one logical conflict with upstream ours and replayed theirs
already integrated upstream leaves an ignored replacement of a deleted ancestor alone
a later picked commit uses its exact parent after an earlier commit was rewritten
unverified replay metadata never guesses a split rename grouping
the initial upstream checkout preserves an ignored rename destination
continuation preserves a working edit introduced by author resolution
independent replay edits follow either renamed side or equal destinations without publishing
